layouts.name: Speedway Park
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The independently mapped full circuit retains the long western straight, northeastern bulb and complete southern inner hairpin and outer return, excluding the northern cut-through and compact kart branches. These course choices match the supplied Speedway Park configuration. The national federation and event organizer identify Speedway Park as the Las Americas venue. The 3142.5 m exact source route remains unscaled against the catalogue 3127 m scalar. Its full branch configuration is retained rather than substituted with a shorter contemporary advertised variant; historical corner alignment remains draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3142.5 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
